Join Uber Eats and become part of a global leader in food delivery that offers flexible work opportunities, competitive earnings, and the freedom to choose your own schedule. Whether you're looking for full-time or part-time work, Uber Eats provides a simple way to earn while delivering food and connecting communities. and flexibility. •            You have a smartphone with an internet connection

•            You have your own bicycle, e-bike, or scooter

Hey, happy face! You always know how to put a smile on someone’s face. That's why you are the perfect driver for Albert Heijn Amsterdam! You have a lot of freedom and your own work van. You also earn a salary of € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks! KATSJINGGG! Are you curious about this position? Then read on and discover how you can apply!

What we offer
- Bring a friend and get € 200!
- Earn € 18,83 per hour after 13 weeks!
- Travel allowance
- Flexible working hours
- Full-time, and part-time options
- A fun and friendly team!

Who you are
As a driver for Albert Heijn, you look forward to drive around on the streets of Amsterdam. You are also able to lift heavy crates. What else is important to know about this job:

- You are available for 12 to 14 hours per week
- You are available for at least two months

Then you get on your bus. Your navigation will lead you to the right locations. Here you scan the groceries in the crates. Time to deliver them to your door! You can also process the payment. Is there anything that needs to be returned? No problem! You take care of that too! Do you have questions about the route? You can contact planning & support for this. Have all orders been placed? Then it's time to return! You will be trained by a buddy on the first working day. Have you mastered everything after a while? Then you can also continue learning to work as a training buddy!

Working days: Monday to Sunday.
Working hours: a shift between 6:00 AM and 3:00 PM and a shift between 1:00 PM and 11:00 P

jobs.description:
Will you be driving a reach truck at DHL in Bemmel soon?

Would you like to start in logistics and develop yourself into a reach truck driver? At our new DHL Supply Chain location in Bemmel, we are looking for logistics employees who want to work with a reach truck.

No certificate yet? No problem: DHL will train you internally to become a reach truck driver – fully on the job and at our expense.

What will you do?

- Operating a reach truck to store and retrieve goods, including at height
- Moving pallets and goods throughout the warehouse
- Picking and scanning orders
- Processing incoming and outgoing goods
- Ensuring a clean, safe, and organized workplace

You will work at a location that is continuously developing, where new clients are regularly being onboarded. This means you will constantly learn new processes.

Good to know: working hours

In July, August, and September, we operate three shifts to handle the busy period:

- 06:00 – 15:00
- 08:00 – 17:00
- 15:00 – 24:00

From October onwards, you will switch to regular day shifts (Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00). Your weekends will be free.

Due to the early and late shifts during the first months, own transportation is recommended.

Who are you?

- You are at least 18 years old
- You are eager to learn and want to develop into a reach truck driver
- You work accurately and with a focus on safety
- You are available for 32 to 40 hours per week in day shifts, Monday to Friday between 07:00 and 18:00
- You speak Dutch or English

A reach truck certificate is a plus, but not required, we value motivation and commitment more, and we will provide your internal training at DHL.
